title: Measurement Research Could Help Devices Tell You If They’ve Been Tampered With
sourceName: National Institute of Standards and Technology
content: Robert D. Horansky received the B.A. degree in chemistry and the Ph.D. degree in physics from the University of Colorado Boulder in 1999 and 2005, respectively. He joined NIST in 2005. Rob has developed metrology techniques for single photon sensors in nuclear radiation and optical power measurements and calibrations and traceability for millimeter-wave wireless systems and reverberation-chamber measurements for cellular applications. Rob is the secretary of the IEEE P1765 Standards Working Group on Uncertainty for EVM and the winner of two Department of Commerce Medals for research in LTE Factor Screening and Novel Single Photon Detectors.
